answer_1.quote: We evaluate the performance of SwapMoE on two common DL tasks: Summarization aims to summarize long texts into short texts... We select the most popular summarization model, Switch Transformer (16, 32, and 64 experts per layer, denoted as SwitchT-16, SwitchT-32 and SwitchT-64) and use the samsum dataset... Language modeling aims to predict the next word given the previous words. We use GPT-SAN as the base model and use the Wikipedia-japanese (wik, 2023) dataset for evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: generated summaries and next-word predictions (token sequences)

answer_2.quote: We select the most popular summarization model, Switch Transformer... and report Rogue-2 accuracy, where higher Rogue-2 accuracy means better. The performance of the language model is measured by perplexity, where lower perplexity means better.
